narrative.intro: Northrop Grumman Systems obligated $2.9B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Northrop Grumman Systems recorded 2 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $1.4B. Northrop Grumman Systems obligations were up 124.5% year over year. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest market for Northrop Grumman Systems in FY2026 to date, accounting for $2.9B of obligations. Engineering Services is a much smaller market for Northrop Grumman Systems in FY2026 to date, accounting for $1.7M of obligations. Looking back, Northrop Grumman Systems obligations by fiscal year were $1.1B in FY21, $2B in FY22, $2.9B in FY23, $3.5B in FY24, $1.3B in FY25, and $2.9B in FY26. Current-year totals for Northrop Grumman Systems are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations.
